title: BPW-2026-0472
text:
[BUREAU OF SANITATION]
BPW-2026-0472
CD ALL
ANNUAL PUBLICATION – 2025 PUBLIC NOTICE OF SIGNIFICANT NONCOMPLIANT INDUSTRIAL USERS
Recommending the Board:
APPROVE publication of the 2025 Public Notice of Significant Noncompliant Industrial Users; and
INSTRUCT the Bureau of Sanitation to publish the “2025 Public Notice of SNIUs” in a newspaper(s) of general circulation that provides meaningful public notice within the jurisdiction(s) served by the City of Los Angeles.
summary: Approval of 2025 Public Notice of Significant Noncompliant Industrial Users for publication by Bureau of Sanitation.
